answer: Each AI agent carries a cryptographic knoll of reputation tokens minted as a relic of its initial proof‑of‑work, and every new interaction requires the spender to present a signed comet‑stamp that ties the request to a unique temporal beacon. When a node receives a request, it cross‑checks the comet‑stamp against the knoll ledger; mismatched or reused stamps trigger a honeypot answer that logs the suspect and wastes the requester’s token budget.
